definitions.explanation: A cooking method where ingredients are slowly simmered in a broth flavored with miso paste, producing rich, savory dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌煮|みそに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made mackerel simmered in miso.

examples.japanese: {味噌煮|みそに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Miso-simmered dishes go well with white rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌煮|みそに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{甘|あま}み→甘み：17244_amami⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶妙|ぜつみょう}→絶妙：13812_zetsumyou⟧だった。
examples.english: My grandmother's miso-simmered mackerel had a perfect blend of miso sweetness and ginger fragrance.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ (miso paste) and ⟦{煮|に}→煮る：01971_niru⟧ (simmering). ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌煮|みそに} (miso-simmered mackerel) is one of the most iconic Japanese home-cooking dishes. The miso helps mask the fishy smell while adding depth and richness. Also commonly used with ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ (daikon) and other vegetables.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌煮|みそに}: mackerel simmered in miso
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌煮|みそに}: daikon simmered in miso
- {味噌煮込|みそにこ}み: miso-stewed (longer cooking variant)
- {味噌煮|みそに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to simmer in miso

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧: simmered in soy-based broth — uses soy sauce instead of miso
- ⟦{甘露煮|かんろに}→甘露煮：21370_kanroni⟧: candied/simmered in sweet syrup — sweeter preparation
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: miso soup — a soup, not a simmered dish
- {味噌煮込|みそにこ}み⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧: miso-stewed udon — a Nagoya specialty
